long_biography.plain_text:
B&K LLC began as a plumbing-products distributor and expanded into domestic and international sourcing, manufacturing and assembly. Moss became president of the Mueller Industries subsidiary in 2015, taking responsibility for a business serving wholesale plumbing customers. Its performance was measured through operating-income and sales-volume targets, tying executive decisions to unit economics.

In 2019, the company adopted the BK Products name to present a more unified identity. Moss positioned the change as a clearer promise of dependable products and service. The rebrand brought longstanding product lines under a common banner while keeping the business focused on wholesalers and plumbing professionals. That blend of operational discipline, product sourcing and customer-facing brand work defined his stewardship of the subsidiary.
